observations: The C++ importer increments its per-type source count before dispatch.
Unknown entity types are consumed, reported in unsupportedFeatures with source line and handle, and do not necessarily fail the import.

The current explicit dispatcher includes LINE, ARC, CIRCLE, MTEXT, TEXT, SOLID, ELLIPSE, SPLINE, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, POINT, INSERT, and DIMENSION; 3DFACE, MESH, 3DSOLID, REGION, and BODY are not routed by this dispatcher.
Classic DXF SOLID is converted to a planar face, not an ACIS-backed solid.
Defaults suppress annotations, paper-space entities, and hidden/system blocks; scale is 1; import mode defaults to IndividualShapes; layers and colors are preserved.
plan_changes: For the composed FreeCAD consumer gate, record exact build/backend, converter status, intermediate DXF version/hash, and importer options.
Reconcile source handle/type manifest against input counters, unsupported line/handle entries, and final FreeCAD object graph; never use entity count alone as import success.
Use a compact scratch-generated discriminator only at the composed checkpoint; add one explicit-options profile only when the claim includes content disabled by defaults.
Keep planar SOLID, 3DFACE/MESH, and ACIS-backed 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY claims separate.
